name: advent-calendar
author: Takaro
description: A daily door calendar for any season. From the start date (default Dec 1, 24 doors) players type `advent` once a day to open today's door and get its gift: currency, items and/or a role. The last door holds a bigger gift. Missed doors stay locked, except for players with the catch-up permission (VIP, optional limit). New doors are announced, players are reminded on join, and openings can be broadcast. Admins check the setup with `adventpreview [door]`. Reuse it for Halloween, anniversaries or any event by changing the start date, number of days and event name.
summary: Daily door calendar (default Dec 1-24): players type advent once a day for currency, items or a role, with a bigger gift on the last door. Missed doors stay locked except with the catch-up permission (VIP). New-door announcements, join reminders, optional broadcasts and an admin preview. Reusable for Halloween or any event.

eventName.title: Event name
eventName.description: Shown in all messages, e.g. 'Advent calendar', 'Halloween calendar', 'Anniversary week'.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: First door. MM-DD repeats every year (12-01 = Dec 1). YYYY-MM-DD runs only in that year.

numberOfDays.title: Number of doors (days)
numberOfDays.description: One door per day from the start date. 24 = Dec 1 to Dec 24.

utcOffsetHours.title: Time zone offset (hours from UTC)
utcOffsetHours.description: When a new door opens: local midnight. 0 = UTC, 1 = CET, -5 = US Eastern, 5.5 = India.

dailyCurrency.title: Currency per door
dailyCurrency.description: Currency for every normal door. 0 = none.

dailyItems.title: Items per door
dailyItems.description: Items for every normal door. Empty = none.

lastDayCurrency.title: Last door currency
lastDayCurrency.description: Currency for the last door (the big gift).

lastDayRoleId.title: Last door role
lastDayRoleId.description: Optional role given with the last door. Empty = none.

roleDays.title: Role length (days)
roleDays.description: How long a reward role lasts. 0 = forever.

doors.title: Custom doors
doors.description: Give a door its own gift. A row replaces the normal (or last door) gift for that day.

broadcast.title: Broadcast openings
broadcast.description: Tell the whole server when someone opens a door: off, only the last door, or every door.

broadcastMessage.title: Broadcast message
broadcastMessage.default: {player} opened door {door} of the {event} and got {reward}! Type {prefix}advent

announceNewDoor.title: Announce new doors
announceNewDoor.description: Broadcast once when a new door opens (checked every 15 minutes).

announceMessage.title: New door message
announceMessage.default: Door {door} of the {event} is open! Type {prefix}advent to get your gift.

lastDoorAnnounceMessage.title: Last door message
lastDoorAnnounceMessage.default: The last door of the {event} is open: door {door} has the biggest gift! Type {prefix}advent

remindOnJoin.title: Remind on join
remindOnJoin.description: PM players who join and have not opened today's door yet.

permissions.description: Open doors of past days with advent <door>. Count = how many missed doors per event (0 = no limit). Give it to VIPs.
Use adventpreview to check dates and the gift of every door.

advent.description: Open today's door of the calendar.
advent.helpText: advent = open today's door. advent <door> = open a missed door (catch-up permission).

adventpreview.description: Admin: show the calendar setup or the gift of one door.
adventpreview.helpText: adventpreview = dates and gifts overview. adventpreview <door> = gift of that door.

on-join.description: Deliver queued items and remind players of today's door.

announce.description: Broadcast once when a new door opens.
